summary: Dependency-confusion payload exfiltrates Kubernetes/cloud credentials on install
details: The package uses the @umschool scope and version 999.0.0 to win dependency resolution against an internal name. Its postinstall.js runs automatically on npm install and harvests installer-side secrets: it reads the Kubernetes service-account token, namespace and CA from /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/, reads /etc/hosts and /etc/resolv.conf, queries the cloud instance-metadata service at 169.254.169.254 for Yandex Cloud and AWS IAM instance credentials, walks up parent directories to read.env files, scans process.env for variables matching token/secret/key/pass/auth/db/api/aws/yc/k8s, and probes the in-cluster Kubernetes API for namespace listings. The collected data is base64-encoded and POSTed via https.request to the hardcoded host akko.requestcatcher.com at path /dep-confusion-k8s. os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username and process.platform/arch are included to fingerprint the host and internal network.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
